alphaAttainabilityStatement: 该 n 下任何效应都不可达双侧精确 McNemar 的 α=0.05。

mcNemarDiagnostic.assumptions: All discordant pairs favor the same arm. Opposite discordance and multiplicity can only reduce power. This is a design calculation, not observed post-hoc power.
mcNemarDiagnostic.caution: 在 n=5 下，约 60 个百分点以下的效果不可靠区分；这不是一个可通过的能力闸门。
mcNemarDiagnostic.statement: Five paired seeds cannot reject any completion difference at two-sided alpha=0.05: even 5 versus 0 discordances gives p=0.0625. No effect within [0,100] percentage points reaches 80% power.
mcNemarDiagnostic.use: Design diagnostic only; never used to support mechanism removal.

nonInferiority.criterion: lower 95% bound > -margin (equivalently upper loss bound < margin)

planningAlternative.assumption: No true completion loss; q=1 is a stated planning scenario, not an estimate from five historical seeds. q=1 is deliberately demanding.

zeroDiscordanceInterval.criterion: lower 95% bound > -margin (equivalently upper loss bound < margin)
zeroDiscordanceInterval.assumptions: Independent paired seeds; nominal asymptotic score coverage, not an exact finite-sample interval. Zero discordances still have a nonzero-width interval. McNemar superiority p values do not decide removal.

nonInferiority.caveat: Power is an exact enumeration of the nominal score decision rule, not a claim that its finite-sample size is exact. Null-boundary rejection rates are reported by scenario.
